This '''rebel faction''', led by [[Llaban]], challenged [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta's]] attempt to [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|unify]] the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Their conflict came to a head at the [[Battle of Kirrek (Unification Wars)|Battle of Kirrek]], where the rebels were ultimately defeated.
